name: Kevin John Duska
note: Born in Montréal by his son's statement (S-000-5). That puts his father, Ahn 4, in Montréal by 1962. A Québec declaration of marriage of 1984 names his father as Steve Duska, born in Czechoslovakia, who also signs as a witness (S-249; image held). The link to Ahn 4 no longer rests on a statement alone. The bride of 1984 was Lyne Lefebvre, born in Montréal in 1964, Kevin's mother, who has died by his statement (S-000-10). She is named here as his wife; her own line is outside this rebuild.
living_basis: Kevin does not know whether his father is living (ledger v8, X-016). Shown by name and year only.

name: Štefan (Stefan, Steve) Duska
note: Son of Michal Duska, Roman Catholic cottar of Senné, and Maria Demko, Greek Catholic, of Iňačovce, by a sealed parish certificate of 1947. Born in Slovakia, not in Canada. Known as Steve; died 2018 (stated, no record in hand). He left Iňačovce with his mother in November 1937, aged 8, on her passport, and sailed from Antwerp for Montréal to join his father (S-252 to S-254). Three papers of 1937 give his birthday as 23 October 1929; the parish certificate has 21 October, which is kept here as the church's own entry. In 1984 he is 'Steve Duska, born in Czechoslovakia' (S-249).
living_basis: Died in 2018 by Kevin's statement to the coordinator (S-000-6).

baptism.place: Roman Catholic parish church, Senné (register vol. IV, p. 110, entry 43)

name: Michal (Mihály, Mike) Duska
note: Born 3 July 1903 at Senné, house 79, son of András Duska, cottar, and Anna Nyemcsik (baptism D-009-79). Identified by the census of 1930: his wife Maria and son Štefan are entered at Senné 145 as the daughter-in-law and grandson of Andrej Duška and Anna, married 18 January 1892 (D-011-24). Married Maria Demko on 30 January 1927 by that census. Roman Catholic cottar of Senné 160 in 1929. Sailed for Canada aged 26, with Mikulas Duska, between November 1929 and July 1930 (D-006-19); naturalised 22 April 1940; at 1196a St. George Street, Montréal, in 1937, when he sent for his family; 'Mike Duska' on his wife's stone; alive in November 1966.

name: Maria Demko (Mary Demko)

birth.place: Iňačovce (Solymos), by her passport of 1937 (S-254); the Demko agent holds the civil registration

note: Wife of Michal Duska and mother of Štefan by the 1947 certificate; Greek Catholic, of Iňačovce. Died at Montréal on 9 September 1950 by her husband's declaration of 1966. Stone: born 1906, died 1950. Her parents are the Demko agent's to establish: it has Mihály Demkó and Mária Kocsis (DM P-018, P-019 @57861ad). Her emigrant passport of 1937 gives her birth as 22 August 1906 at Iňačovce and her occupation as farmer; she left in November 1937 with her son. The census of 1930 has her at Senné 145 in her father-in-law's house, married 30 January 1927, with a birth date of 15 August 1907 that disagrees with her passport.

name: András (Andrej) Duska
note: Roman Catholic servant, then cottar and day-labourer of Senné: houses 73, 92, 79, 98, 138 and, in 1930, 145. Married Anna Nyemcsik on 18 January 1892. Father of Michal by the census of 1930 and the baptism of 1903. Could not read or write. A death date of 22 August 1940 is noted beside a baptism of [1868] that is probably his (H-048); that he is the son of György Duska the elder and Anna Krak rests on the marriage entry, which has no archive reference yet.

name: Anna Nyemcsik (Nemčíková; written Minarcsin and Nyemecz)
note: Wife of András Duska from 18 January 1892; twelve children, nine living in 1930. Her birth date in the census is the date of the baptism of Anna, daughter of János Nyemcsik and Erzsébet Hresko, in the Senné register (H-051). She could read.
